body:
## Pull request overview

Wires the sidebar user dropdown’s “Settings” entry to navigate to the existing profile route, and adds an integration test to ensure the profile route renders within the console app.

**Changes:**
- Added `useNavigate()` usage in `AppSidebar` and hooked “Settings” to navigate to `/apps/${activeAppName}/system/profile`.
- Added a route-level integration test ensuring `system/profile` renders (via a mocked `ProfilePage`).

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated 2 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| apps/console/src/components/AppSidebar.tsx | Adds navigation behavior to the Settings dropdown item in the user menu. |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/ConsoleApp.test.tsx | Adds a new integration test for rendering the profile route (with `ProfilePage` mocked). |

`DropdownMenuItem` from Radix is primarily activated via `onSelect` (including keyboard selection). Using `onClick` here can make the Settings item not work for keyboard users. Prefer `onSelect={() => navigate(...)}` (or render a `<Link>` via `asChild`) to keep the menu accessible and consistent with other dropdown-menu rendering in the codebase (e.g. packages/components/src/renderers/overlay/dropdown-menu.tsx uses `onSelect`).
